question: Compare Snowflake and Databricks on data warehousing

findings.claim: Snowflake describes its data warehousing programme.
findings.evidence: Snowflake states that its data warehousing programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
findings.title: Snowflake platform overview

findings.claim: Databricks describes its data warehousing programme.
findings.evidence: Databricks states that its data warehousing programme is organised around partner platforms.
findings.title: Databricks platform overview

findings.evidence: Both Snowflake and Databricks report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
findings.title: Partnership summary

findings.claim: An analyst note compares the two approaches.
findings.evidence: The note contrasts Snowflake's in-house delivery with Databricks's partner-led model.
findings.title: Analyst note

findings.claim: Snowflake discloses investment in data warehousing capability.
findings.evidence: Snowflake discloses continued investment in data warehousing training and certification.
findings.title: Snowflake investment disclosure

findings.claim: Databricks discloses investment in data warehousing capability.
findings.evidence: Databricks discloses continued investment in data warehousing delivery centres.
findings.title: Databricks investment disclosure

sections.heading: How Snowflake and Databricks organise data warehousing
sections.body: Snowflake runs data warehousing through a dedicated unit, while Databricks organises the same work around partner platforms. The two structures lead to different delivery models.

sections.heading: Partnerships and investment
sections.body: Both Snowflake and Databricks report platform partnerships, and both disclose continued investment in data warehousing capability, though in different places.

claims.text: Snowflake delivers data warehousing work through a dedicated business unit.
Databricks organises data warehousing work around partner platforms.
Both Snowflake and Databricks report multi-year platform partnerships.
Snowflake and Databricks both disclose continued data warehousing investment.

verdicts.quote: Snowflake states that its data warehousing programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
Databricks states that its data warehousing programme is organised around partner platforms.
Both Snowflake and Databricks report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
Snowflake discloses continued investment in data warehousing training and certification.
